nom: Cetaphil Gentle Skin Cleanser Face Wash, For Sensitive Skin

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin repeatedly report no burning, stinging, or irritation, and describe the cleanser as calming and safe even with eye area contact, allergies, lupus, or eczema, though one reviewer with 40 years of use says a reformulation now burns like acid.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin say it cleanses without stripping or tightening and leaves skin hydrated, though a few find it not moisturizing enough on its own and pair it with a heavier cream.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin have mixed experiences: some say it controls oil and helps with acne, while others find it leaves a residual oily or greasy feel and call it too light for real oil control.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe it as non-drying and non-irritating, with skin left clean and tight-but-hydrated.
segments.mature: One reviewer describes it as a good daily hydrating option for sensitive aging skin, but no broader anti-aging effect is reported.

concerns.aging: Only a single mention exists, describing the product as suitable for daily use on sensitive, aging skin, with no anti-aging claims reported.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report the cleanser hydrates and doesn't strip natural oils, leaving skin soft; a couple say it is not hydrating enough on its own and needs a moisturizer, and one reformulation complaint describes severe dryness and burning.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with redness or rosacea report it calms and does not trigger flare-ups, with one saying it visibly reduced redness on the cheeks and another crediting it alongside dermatologist care for clearing rosacea.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers with a reactive or compromised barrier (eczema, atopic dermatitis, psoriasis) report the cleanser is soothing and does not sting or worsen their condition; one long-term user says a recent reformulation instead damaged her barrier with severe burning.
concerns.spots: One reviewer says it clears pimples and blemishes effectively; no dissent is present on this specific point.
concerns.blemishes: Multiple acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and clearer skin over time; however, at least three reviewers describe new acne, including cystic-type breakouts on the face and neck, which they attribute to a recent formula change or a possibly bad batch.
concerns.oiliness: Reports are split: some oily-skin reviewers say it helped manage oiliness and acne, while others say it leaves a lingering oily or greasy after-feel and doesn't feel like it is actually cleaning.

aspects.libelle: Good value for large bottle size

extraits.titre: You RUINED the best facial cleanser ever made!
extraits.texte: The opposite of Gentle!!!! I've been using Cetaphil cleanser for 40 years!!!! Since my dermatologist recommended when I was 16 after a reaction to soap. Because it was not irritating and sensitive! You all didn't reformulate you made an entirely different product. The only same ingredient is water! There was nothing else like this product ever made. Stop listening to the stupidity of people trying to erase ingredients. They can choose to not buy the product. But for those of us who need the Original formula to have our skin survive and who supported you Cetaphil, this is what you do to your loyal customers?! This new formula is not made for dry or sensitive skin. It's like pouring acid on it. The burning and pain is insane! I'm outraged. I just bought several bottles I'll have to through away. But the worst part is I have nothing safe for cleaning my face now. I have recommended the original product to tons of people over the past 40 yrs. More than any other product I've used. So many companies are ruining their products. I was so thankful and prayed you all never would. Cetaphil original formula gentle cleanser for sensitive skin was the only product in my life I'd choose to stay the same if I had one choice. So furious and so disappointed. What a betrayal of your company and name to us. Offer a new product with this new formula. But bring back the ORIGINAL formula for those who stayed with you for decades so we can continue to buy it!

extraits.titre: Better than expensive brands for Rosacea
extraits.texte: I used this for a long time and then switched to other products to diminish my brown spots. I developed rosacea and came back to this with recommendation from my dermatologist. My face is moisturized and cleared up using this and other prescriptions.
Fragrance free no smell at all perfect for sensitive skin. Super hydrating does not strip your skin leaves it soft & moisturized. Very gentle no burning or redness great for acne prone skin.

This cleanser has been a surprise. I have oily to combination skin and I've always used cleansers that would be a bit harsh because I thought I needed those to deep clean, but this gentle cleanser has been a game changer. It doesn't make a foam, it feels more like a cream but it cleans the skin really well without taking all the life out of your face. It doesn't leave any residue. The price value for this huge bottle is amazing. This is my go to, ever since starting with tretinoin. I would definitely recommend it!

extraits.titre: Great results on my sensitive, acne-prone skin
extraits.texte: As a woman with sensitive, acne-prone skin, this product has been a holy grail for me for many years. I use it almost every morning and night. It goes on easily and leaves my skin feeling soft and clean. I have combination skin, and this isn't drying for me at all. I restock this product consistently. I don't plan on trying a new face wash anytime soon - this one is my tried and true!

This skin cleanser never disappoints. The pimples and blemishes on my face are no match for it. It feels like I'm washing my face with silk and NEVER irritates my eyes of cuts. This is absolutely a buy-again! Don't even get me started on the lotion! Its the best part for my dry, eczema-prone skin!

Not sure if maybe the bottle I bought was a bad batch but it feels so oily on my skin and I've started to break out in acne on my face and upper neck. The color looks a little yellowish too and I just bought it a month ago.
